title: Not Worth the Price.
text:
The box costs $19.99. The estimated value of the products in the box is $25.

I attempted to look up the price of each item individually, could only find the treats

They estimated the 2 oz bag of treats at $4.00. In reality, they were $2.39. The 6 oz bag of the treats is around the $4 mark.

Which leads me to believe the other items were not the price they were valued at, especially the cat wand at $7.

As for your cats enjoying the box? Mine loved the box at first, but when the catnip wore away (not even a day or two), they had no interest.

They weren't too impressed with most items in the box, with the exception of the wand and treats.

I just did not see any real value in it.
label: neutral
